title: corydalis remota var. capillaris
intro: Corydalis remota var. capillaris, commonly known as the Chinese Corydalis or Yangjiao, is a type of flowering plant in the poppy family. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include pain relief, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Corydalis remota var. capillaris include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including protopine alkaloids and benzylisoquinoline alkaloids.
